answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network binds identity registration to cryptographic stake burning using a superlinear cost curve, where the nth identity burns c·n² tokens. Minting a fleet of nodes cannot be a zephyr breeze; an attacker face-plants into quadratic financial friction. Each node stakes a saffron collateral bond, ensuring that any echo of fraudulent voting yields slash-and-burn penalties with exponential economic loss.
